question: Should the repair lane adopt this fail-closed authorization and credential-renewal contract now, accepting that stale or incomplete state will pause mutations until a fresh review or retry?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and well-covered, but it deliberately changes the trusted-write boundary and failure behavior of live repair automation; only maintainers can accept that rollout and operator tradeoff.

options.title: Approve guarded rollout
options.body: Land the exact reviewed head after a canary confirms stale target, covering-PR, and check drift block while current authorized mutations and deferred publication still complete.

options.title: Narrow the first rollout
options.body: Merge only the request-boundary authorization guards and defer credential renewal or wider receipt integration to a separately reviewed change.

options.title: Pause the rollout
options.body: Keep the current mutation behavior until maintainers define different availability or compatibility requirements for stale-state handling.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded rollout
recommendation.body: Land the exact reviewed head after a canary confirms stale target, covering-PR, and check drift block while current authorized mutations and deferred publication still complete.
